en.t: A faint smile rose on A Guang's face.

units.source_text: 她心想：在这样拥挤的人群里，只顾眺望表演节目的小帐篷，

en.t: She thought: in such a crowded mass of people, with everyone only gazing toward the little performance tent,

units.source_text: 谁也没发现这孩子异常敏捷的动作……真了不起。

en.t: no one had noticed this child's extraordinarily quick movements... it was truly remarkable.

units.source_text: 一个头戴便帽、学生模样的人——他眼露凶光，竖起大招风耳，

en.t: One man, wearing a flat cap and looking like a student, had a fierce glint in his eyes and large protruding ears sticking up,

units.source_text: 同另一个悬着塌鼻子的年轻人——他系着一条窄硬腰带，不像是学生，

en.t: together with another young man with a flattened nose hanging down; he wore a narrow, stiff belt and did not look like a student,

units.source_text: 他们两人抓住帐篷前围着的栏杆，站在最前面，

en.t: the two of them gripped the railing around the front of the tent and stood at the very front,

units.source_text: 直勾勾地望着阿光的脸。

en.t: staring fixedly at A Guang's face.
